short: The capture of the major Baltic port of Riga by Russian forces, cementing Russian control over Livonia.
full:
The Siege of Riga began in November 1709 and ended on 4 July 1710 when the Swedish garrison capitulated to the besieging Russian army under General Boris Sheremetev. Following the Swedish disaster at Poltava, Russian forces systematically reduced Sweden's Baltic strongholds. Riga, one of the wealthiest and most fortified cities in the Swedish Empire, was a primary target.

The siege was characterized by intense bombardment and an outbreak of bubonic plague that devastated both the defenders and the civilian population. The fall of Riga, along with other Baltic ports, effectively eliminated Swedish control over the eastern Baltic coastline and integrated Livonia into the Russian Empire.
